summary: Web-layer regression check after Capacitor Android scaffolding. All web routes (/,  /auth, /reset-password, /visa-check, /countries) render HTTP 200 with zero JS console errors. Unknown routes return 404. /api/health returns 503 with the exact documented JSON shape (AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY:false, AI_GATEWAY_BASE_URL:false, SUPABASE_URL:true, SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY:true). /api/chat returns 400 for missing messages and 500 'Missing AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY' for a valid messages array — both matching designed behaviour. All 5 vitest tests across 3 files (auth-redirects, combobox-viewport, runtime-health) pass. Capacitor config, Android build.gradle, AndroidManifest.xml deep-link intent filters, and .gitignore entries all verified.

endpoint_verification.GET /auth: 200 (renders sign-in form, email input present, title='Sign in — Asvior')
endpoint_verification.GET /api/health: 503 with {ok:false, required:{AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY:false, AI_GATEWAY_BASE_URL:false, SUPABASE_URL:true, SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY:true}} — MATCH
endpoint_verification.POST /api/chat {messages:[...]}: 500 'Missing AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY' — MATCH (designed behaviour when AI env absent)

capacitor_config_verification.AndroidManifest.xml: Both intent-filters present: (a) android:scheme='asvior' with autoVerify='false'; (b) autoVerify='true' with data android:scheme='https' android:host='asvior.app' — OK
capacitor_config_verification..gitignore: Contains android/local.properties, android/keystore.properties, android/**/*.jks, android/**/*.keystore, android/**/build/, android/app/src/main/assets/public/ — OK

vitest_results: 3 files, 5 tests, all passed (auth-redirects, combobox-viewport, runtime-health)
browser_console_check: 0 JS errors across /, /auth, /reset-password, /visa-check, /countries — Supabase client's isNative branching to localStorage on web is functioning (no 'window is not defined' crashes)
critical_code_review_comments: Capacitor server.url points to https://asvior.app (production) — so the packaged Android app is a WebView wrapper around prod. This means local dev changes won't appear in the Android build until re-deployed. This is intentional per config comment but should be documented for future contributors.

detectSessionInUrl=!isNative on native is correct for PKCE deep-link flow; native-init.ts exchange must be robust to double-invocation (App.appUrlOpen can fire on cold-start and warm resume) — recommend guarding with a processed-code set. (Not a regression, forward-looking.)
test_credentials: N/A — no auth flows exercised per request
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web dev server started via `cd /app && (nohup npm run dev > /tmp/asvior-dev.log 2>&1 &)` on port 3000. TanStack Start app (not FastAPI). Vitest runs via `npm run test:run`. Android runtime verification is out-of-scope (no SDK/emulator in this container) — the user has been told those are manual. Do NOT sign up real Supabase users.
